description: 2D sprite kit, both crafts into one atlas. VECTOR: SVG rigs posed by phase, Illustrator construction verbs (offset, booleans, smooth, roundCorners, mirrorX, hue ramps, rim light), contact-sheet previews, and an opt-in native Pixi projection for joints gameplay must keep live. PIXEL: an indexed grid with drawing verbs (line, rect, ellipse, flood fill, mirror, wrap-shift, auto-outline, ramp shade, dither, replace colour), 8x nearest-neighbour/onion-skin/frame-diff/self-tiling previews, and live grid textures for art the game erodes while it plays. Both bake headlessly with resvg through maxrects packing to a standard spritesheet, against the same cycle-set contracts, and play on the game-time AnimatedSprite runtime.
title: Sprite kit
